description: Defines a base class for testing decoding of HTTP/2 and HPACK encodings, including helper functions and mechanisms for segmenting input buffers and validating decoding results.

classes.name: RandomDecoderTest
classes.description: A base class for testing the decoding of byte sequences with various buffer segmentations, supporting validation and buffer boundary testing.

methods.name: ToStringPiece
methods.description: Converts an array of data into an absl::string_view.

methods.name: CorruptEnum
methods.description: Overwrites an enum value with a random value, possibly invalid, for testing purposes.

methods.name: StopDecodeOnDone
methods.description: Returns whether decoding should stop when a DecodeStatus of kDecodeDone is encountered.

methods.name: DecodeSegments
methods.description: Decodes a buffer in segments determined by a selection function, returning the final decode status.

methods.name: DecodeSegmentsAndValidate
methods.description: Decodes buffer segments and validates the final decoding result.

methods.name: SelectRemaining
methods.description: Returns a function that selects the remaining bytes for decoding.

methods.name: SelectOne
methods.description: Returns a function that selects one byte at a time for decoding.

methods.name: SelectZeroAndOne
methods.description: Returns a function that alternates between zero and one byte segments.

methods.name: SelectRandom
methods.description: Returns a function that selects random segment sizes for decoding.

methods.name: DecodeAndValidateSeveralWays
methods.description: Decodes a buffer multiple times with different segmentations, validating each time.

methods.name: ToValidator
methods.description: Converts various validator types into a standard AssertionResult validator.

methods.name: ValidateDoneAndEmpty
methods.description: Validator that checks if decoding is done and the buffer is empty.

methods.name: ValidateDoneAndOffset
methods.description: Validator that checks if decoding is done and the buffer offset matches expected.
